war_summary: On Day 116 of War 139, heavy fighting and rapid base turnover remain concentrated across volatile island hexes and core contested frontlines. Simultaneously, active base captures and neutralizations are unfolding in Onyx and Stema Landing, while Clahstra sustains intense combat pressure and severe casualty exchanges.
